snc.text: Xander, the leader of the Maestros, worried about the balance of power in New Capenna and ordered Anhelo to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply.

Xander needed a spy and Elspeth wanted answers, so he told her New Capenna was founded by a deal between archangels and demonlords against an unknown enemy, and he named her an officer of the Maestros in exchange for infiltrating the Cabaretti.
On the eve of the Crescendo, Xander named Anhelo his heir, then confronted the Adversary and was blasted from the viewing deck at Park Heights, falling into the clouds below.
Ob Nixilis revelled over Xander's body but learned that Xander had played him and the Font had escaped, and Xander's letter later gave Elspeth access to his archives.
